verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Superhuman offers an MCP server for AI assistants to pull/push data, plus in-app automation triggers ('agents that run proactively based on triggers you set'), but there is no mention of a webhook subscription mechanism for external systems to receive event notifications. Probes for API/OpenAPI specs return 404s, and no webhook docs exist. missing for 10: any documented webhook endpoint, event schema, or subscription API for outbound notifications.
